title: Iconic CAD Housing Library Registry
text: '''Note:''' This is a working page. The key point of this is the first column - where the actual library will be found on the wiki. The last column defines the specific scope so that development does not overlap. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%; table-layout:fixed;" ! style="width:8%;" | Registry ID !! style="width:10%;" | Icon (with link to source material) !! style="width:14%;" | Reference Information !! style="width:14%;" | Reference Info Wiki target !! style="width:54%;" | Notes |- | ICHL-303 || [[File:303_drywall.webp|80px|link=Door Framing]] || [[Iconic Drywall|Drywall]] || Drywall || '''Interior sheathing.''' Scope: defines drywall technique. Intefaces with studs and blocking underneath, surface trim, surface-mounted devices, penetrations (wiring, plumbing, HVAC), and edge/corner trim. |- | ICHL-302 || [[File:302_Door_Framing.webp|80px|link=Door Framing]] || [[Door Framing|Door Framing]] || Door Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines framing around interior and exterior door rough openings, including headers where required, king studs, jack studs, cripple studs, blocking, and connections to adjacent wall framing. Includes fastener schedule and exterior sheathing. Boundary: excludes the door unit, jambs, threshold, hardware, trim, flashing, and weather sealing; garage-door-specific framing components are covered separately. |- | ICHL-001 || [[File:001_site_plan.webp|80px|link=Iconic Site Plan]] || [[Iconic Site Plan|Site Plan]] || Iconic Site Plan || '''Plan / reference artifact.''' Scope: Defines house placement, footprint, orientation, major access and utility connection reference points on the site. Includes landscape trees and plantings, hardscape, waterscape if any. Boundary: excludes detailed grading, trench, landscape, foundation, or building-component geometry. |- | ICHL-002 || [[File:002_site_grading.webp|80px|link=1_Grading_+_Site_Prep]] || [[1_Grading_+_Site_Prep|Site Grading]] || 1_Grading_+_Site_Prep || '''Site-work process / geometry.''' Scope: Defines the earthwork needed to establish building pad, drainage intent, slopes, and finished-grade relationships around the house. Boundary: excludes foundation construction, utility installation, hardscape finish, and broader site-development grading. |- | ICHL-003 || [[File:003_foundation_plumbing.webp|80px|link=2_Foundation_Plumbing]] || [[2_Foundation_Plumbing|Foundation Plumbing]] || 2_Foundation_Plumbing || '''Plumbing rough-in assembly.''' Scope: Defines water lines, plumbing lines, and any other lines located in or below the foundation before the foundation closes. All stub-outs must be closed off with caps or suitable blocking to prevent concrete from entering during the pour. Boundary: extends to the exterior connection point where the foundation plumbing connects to the onward plumbing leading to the sewer, and to the interior stub-outs above the finished foundation. |- | ICHL-004 || [[File:004_foundation.webp|80px|link=3_Foundation_(Slab_or_Portable)]] || [[3_Foundation_(Slab_or_Portable)|Foundation]] || 3_Foundation_(Slab_or_Portable) || '''Concrete foundation pour / finishing process.''' Scope: Defines how the slab foundation concrete pour is carried out, including an attached garage slab where present. Includes concrete-truck access and placement arrangements, or accommodations for mixing concrete on site; concrete placement, screeding, floating, and troweling; and post-processing such as polishing, relief cuts, concrete sealer, or other coatings. Boundary: begins with the foundation forms completely finished and covers pour logistics, execution, finishing, and post-processing. Excludes construction or installation of the forms, underlying materials, insulation, reinforcement, foundation plumbing, Ufer ground, and embedded fasteners; preparation of those components is covered separately. |- | ICHL-005 || [[File:005_slab_foundation_forms.webp|80px|link=Slab Foundation Forms]] || [[Slab Foundation Forms|Slab Foundation Forms]] || Slab Foundation Forms || '''Foundation preparation / pre-pour assembly.''' Scope: Defines everything prepared for the slab foundation up to the concrete pour, including formwork and supports; gravel and other underlying materials; frost-protected footer vertical insulation; rebar and other reinforcement; foundation plumbing and other lines; the Ufer ground; and preparation and positioning of embedded fasteners such as sill plate anchor bolts. Foundation plumbing and the Ufer ground are specified in separate modules and can be transcluded into this module's documentation. Boundary: ends when foundation preparation is complete and ready for concrete placement. Excludes the concrete pour, floating, troweling, and post-processing, which are covered in ICHL-004. |- | ICHL-006 || [[File:006_slab_foundation_frost_protected_footer.webp|80px|link=Slab Foundation Frost Protected Footer]] || [[Slab Foundation Frost Protected Footer|Slab Foundation Frost Protected Footer]] || Slab Foundation Frost Protected Footer || '''Frost-protected footer completion assembly.''' Scope: Defines the portions of the frost-protected footer not included in Slab Foundation Forms (ICHL-005), including horizontal insulation sections, protective barriers, and any other components required to complete the frost-protected footer up to the point of being ready for burial. Boundary: excludes the vertical insulation already included in ICHL-005 and ends with the remaining footer components installed and ready for burial; burial and backfilling are excluded. |- | ICHL-007 || [[File:007_universal_stabilized_subgrade_foundation.webp|80px|link=Universal Stabilized Subgrade Foundation]] || [[Universal Stabilized Subgrade Foundation|Universal Stabilized Subgrade Foundation]] || Universal Stabilized Subgrade Foundation || '''Foundation / subgrade system.''' Scope: Defines the stabilized subgrade layers and foundation base that create a buildable, load-spreading base beneath the house, including insulation and earth anchors. Boundary: extends upward to the completed foundation base, ready for installation of the first-floor walls, and downward through all subgrade stabilization layers, including the vapor barrier and grading necessary for this foundation system. Excludes installation of the first-floor walls. |- | ICHL-008 || [[File:008_foundation_base_cover.webp|80px|link=3.5_Foundation_Base_Cover]] || [[3.5_Foundation_Base_Cover|Foundation Base Cover]] || 3.5_Foundation_Base_Cover || '''Foundation-envelope component.''' Scope: Defines protection of the exposed foundation base and moisture management at the transition to the bottom of the exterior wall. Includes details for both stabilized subgrade and slab foundations; these differ by foundation type but are grouped here because they serve similar functions. The intended design uses the same cladding for foundation-base protection as for the exterior wall, greatly simplifying this detail, particularly with metal siding. Accommodates siding extending flush with the foundation base and includes measures to manage moisture and keep the base area clean from splash. Boundary: excludes the structural foundation and below-grade waterproofing not part of this cover. |- | ICHL-009 || [[File:009_electrical_trenching.webp|80px|link=Electrical Trenching]] || [[Electrical Trenching|Electrical Trenching]] || Electrical Trenching || '''Site utility trench / conduit assembly.''' Scope: Defines the route, excavation, depth/grade, bedding/backfill, house-entry relationship, and all conduit necessary for the electrical service between the utility service and the power meter at the house. Boundary: extends from the utility pole or ground-mounted transformer at the utility end all the way to the power meter at the house end, including the complete conduit run between these endpoints. Excludes the utility equipment itself, interior distribution, and unrelated earthwork. |- | ICHL-010 || [[File:010_water_trenching.webp|80px|link=Water Trenching]] || [[Water Trenching|Water Trenching]] || Water Trenching || '''Site utility trench / process.''' Scope: Defines the route, excavation, depth/grade, bedding/backfill, and house-entry relationship for the domestic water service. Boundary: excludes the utility equipment itself, interior distribution, and unrelated earthwork. |- | ICHL-011 {{check}} || [[File:011_water_meter.webp|80px|link=Water Meter]] || [[Water Meter|Water Meter]] || Water Meter || '''Domestic-water service connection / metering assembly.''' Scope: Includes the connection starting at the municipal water-service tap, piping from that tap to the water meter, the water meter with its required connection orientation and access, and piping from the meter to the house supply line at the house entrance. Boundary: extends from the connection at the municipal water-service tap to the connection with the house supply line at the house entrance. Excludes the municipal supply network upstream of the tap and the house's downstream water distribution. |- | ICHL-012 || [[File:012_ufer_ground.webp|80px|link=Ufer Ground]] || [[Ufer Ground|Ufer Ground]] || Ufer Ground || '''Electrical grounding component.''' Scope: Defines the concrete-encased grounding electrode and its connection point to the electrical grounding system. Boundary: excludes the complete grounding electrode system, panel bonding, branch-circuit grounding, and lightning protection. |- | ICHL-013 || [[File:013_sewer_trenching.webp|80px|link=Sewer Trenching]] || [[Sewer Trenching|Sewer Trenching]] || Sewer Trenching || '''Site utility trench / process.''' Scope: Defines the route, excavation, depth/grade, bedding/backfill, and house-entry relationship for the plumbing/sewer service. Boundary: excludes the utility equipment itself, interior distribution, and unrelated earthwork. |- | ICHL-014 || [[File:014_sewer_pipe_and_connection.webp|80px|link=Sewer Pipe and Connection]] || [[Sewer Pipe and Connection|Sewer Pipe And Connection]] || Sewer Pipe and Connection || '''Sewer service assembly.''' Scope: Defines the house sewer lateral and connection at the external sewer boundary, including pipe routing/slope and connection fittings. Boundary: excludes interior fixture drains and the municipal sewer network beyond the connection point. |- | [[ICHL-015]] || [[File:015_wall_framing.webp|80px|link=Wall Framing]] || [[Wall Framing|Wall Framing]] || Wall Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the wall, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-016 || [[File:016_window_framing.webp|80px|link=Window Framing]] || [[Window Framing|Window Framing]] || Window Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the window, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-017 || [[File:017_roof_framing.webp|80px|link=Roof Framing]] || [[Roof Framing|Roof Framing]] || Roof Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the roof, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-018 || [[File:018_terrace_framing.webp|80px|link=Terrace Framing]] || [[Terrace Framing|Terrace Framing]] || Terrace Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the terrace, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-019 || [[File:019_deck_framing.webp|80px|link=Deck Framing]] || [[Deck Framing|Deck Framing]] || Deck Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the deck, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-020 || [[File:020_canopy_framing.webp|80px|link=Canopy Framing]] || [[Canopy Framing|Canopy Framing]] || Canopy Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the canopy, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-021 || [[File:021_enclosed_porch_framing.webp|80px|link=Enclosed Porch Framing]] || [[Enclosed Porch Framing|Enclosed Porch Framing]] || Enclosed Porch Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the enclosed porch, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-022 || [[File:022_stairs.webp|80px|link=5_Stairs]] || [[5_Stairs|Stairs]] || 5_Stairs || '''Stair structural/architectural assembly.''' Scope: Defines the stair flight geometry and primary support needed to connect floor elevations. Boundary: excludes finish trim, handrails, and transition strips unless integral to the stair schema. |- | ICHL-023 || [[File:023_interior_walls.webp|80px|link=Interior Walls]] || [[Interior Walls|Interior Walls]] || Interior Walls || '''Interior partition system.''' Scope: Defines non-exterior wall framing/partition geometry and its openings/support requirements. Boundary: excludes exterior envelope walls, finishes, and utility contents except at explicit interfaces. |- | ICHL-024 || [[File:024_second_floor_platform.webp|80px|link=Second Floor Platform]] || [[Second Floor Platform|Second Floor Platform]] || Second Floor Platform || '''Floor structural platform assembly.''' Scope: Defines the second-floor load-bearing platform, datum, perimeter, and connection geometry. Boundary: excludes finished flooring, ceiling finish below, and unrelated wall/roof framing. |- | ICHL-025 || [[File:025_deck.webp|80px|link=22_Deck]] || [[22_Deck|Deck]] || 22_Deck || '''Exterior platform assembly.''' Scope: Defines the deck structure/platform as an occupiable exterior assembly. Boundary: excludes landscape/hardscape, independent canopy systems, and finish furnishings. |- | ICHL-026 || [[File:026_garage_framing.webp|80px|link=Garage Framing]] || [[Garage Framing|Garage Framing]] || Garage Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the garage, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-027 || [[File:027_enclosed_back_porch_framing.webp|80px|link=Enclosed Back Porch Framing]] || [[Enclosed Back Porch Framing|Enclosed Back Porch Framing]] || Enclosed Back Porch Framing || '''Structural framing assembly.''' Scope: Defines the load-bearing framing for the enclosed back porch, including primary members, openings, blocking, and connection faces. Boundary: excludes sheathing, insulation, finish layers, and MEP systems except where they constrain framing. |- | ICHL-028 || [[File:028_quad_modules.webp|80px|link=Quad Modules]] || [[Quad Modules|Quad Modules]] || Quad Modules || '''Structural module family / assembly.''' Scope: Defines the four-module structural arrangement called a quad and the geometry needed to combine its constituent framing modules. Boundary: excludes the detailed design of each constituent wall/floor/roof module and nonstructural finishes. |- | ICHL-029 || [[File:029_penetrations.webp|80px|link=Penetrations]] || [[Penetrations|Penetrations]] || Penetrations || '''Cross-system opening / interface feature.''' Scope: Defines intentionally created openings through structure or envelope for utilities, vents, ducts, or other services. Boundary: excludes the service equipment itself and accidental field holes not represented as designed penetrations. |- | ICHL-030 || [[File:030_roof_insulation.webp|80px|link=Roof Insulation]] || [[Roof Insulation|Roof Insulation]] || Roof Insulation || '''Thermal insulation assembly.''' Scope: Defines insulation located at the roof structure and its continuity, thickness, and fit around framing. Boundary: excludes roof membrane, roof decking structure, and wall/foundation insulation. |- | ICHL-031 || [[File:031_Hangar.webp|80px|link=Iconic Hangar]] || [[Iconic Hangar|Hangar]] || Iconic Hangar || '''Building-scale structure / reference assembly.''' Scope: Represents the Iconic Hangar as a larger structural assembly built from reusable framing principles. Boundary: excludes production-house-only details that are not shared with or applicable to the hangar. |- | ICHL-032 || [[File:032_Cabins.webp|80px|link=Cabins]] || [[Cabins|Cabins]] || Cabins || '''Building-scale structure / reference family.''' Scope: Represents cabin assemblies and their reusable house-module relationships. Boundary: excludes site infrastructure and details unique to larger production houses unless explicitly reused. |- | ICHL-033 || [[File:033_Bamboo.webp|80px|link=Iconic Bamboo]] || [[Iconic Bamboo|Bamboo]] || Iconic Bamboo || '''Material / structural-system concept — needs confirmation.''' Scope: Represents the bamboo-related structural or building application intended by the ICHL icon set. Boundary: excludes generic bamboo knowledge outside the documented OSE construction application; exact boundary should be confirmed from the linked page. |- | ICHL-034 || [[File:034_Rapid_Learning_Facility.webp|80px|link=Iconic Rapid Learning Facility]] || [[Iconic Rapid Learning Facility|Rapid Learning Facility]] || Iconic Rapid Learning Facility || '''Building-scale structure / reference assembly.''' Scope: Represents the Rapid Learning Facility geometry and reusable construction-system relationships. Boundary: excludes production-house details that are not applicable to the RLF. |- | ICHL-035 || [[File:035_CEB_Walls.webp|80px|link=CEB Walls]] || [[CEB Walls|CEB Walls]] || CEB Walls || '''Wall system.''' Scope: Defines compressed-earth-block wall assemblies and their structural/envelope connection requirements. Boundary: excludes wood-framed wall modules except at explicit interfaces, and CEB manufacturing itself. |- | ICHL-036 || [[File:036_Utility_Wall_Integration.webp|80px|link=Utility Wall Integration]] || [[Utility Wall Integration|Utility Wall Integration]] || Utility Wall Integration || '''Integration system / coordination object.''' Scope: Defines how the utility wall combines framing, plumbing, electrical, fixtures, cabinetry, and service access into one coordinated zone. Boundary: excludes the full detailed schema of each constituent subsystem when it can be referenced independently. |- | ICHL-037 || [[File:037_Interior_Utility_Systems.webp|80px|link=Interior Utility Systems]] || [[Interior Utility Systems|Interior Utility Systems]] || Interior Utility Systems || '''Utility-system collection / coordination object.''' Scope: Defines interior utility subsystems and their spatial/service relationships within the house. Boundary: excludes site utility networks and unrelated architectural finishes. |- | ICHL-038 || [[File:038_Build_Workflows.webp|80px|link=Build Workflows]] || [[Build Workflows|Build Workflows]] || Build Workflows || '''Development / construction process.''' Scope: Defines build sequences, dependencies, parallelizable work, handoffs, and completion gates. Boundary: excludes the physical geometry of the resulting modules except where sequence depends on it. |- | ICHL-039 || [[File:039_Master_Tool_List.webp|80px|link=Master Tool List]] || [[Master Tool List|Master Tool List]] || Master Tool List || '''Reference / resource registry.''' Scope: Defines the canonical set of tools required or recommended for ICHL construction tasks. Boundary: excludes parts, fasteners, materials, and task instructions except as references. |- | ICHL-040 || [[File:040_Master_Part_List.webp|80px|link=Master Part List]] || [[Master Part List|Master Part List]] || Master Part List || '''Reference / part registry.''' Scope: Defines the canonical list of physical parts used across the housing library. Boundary: excludes tools, raw-material quantities, fasteners as a separate registry, and assembled-module geometry. |- | ICHL-041 || [[File:041_Master_Fastener_List.webp|80px|link=Master Fastener List]] || [[Master Fastener List|Master Fastener List]] || Master Fastener List || '''Reference / fastener registry.''' Scope: Defines fastener types, sizes, and intended uses across housing modules. Boundary: excludes non-fastener parts, tools, and connection geometry beyond what is needed to identify use. |- | ICHL-042 || [[File:042_Iconic_Build_Technique.webp|80px|link=Iconic Build Technique]] || [[Iconic Build Technique|Iconic Build Technique]] || Iconic Build Technique || '''Technique / design-for-build knowledge.''' Scope: Defines reusable OSE construction techniques and execution principles intended to make the house fast, teachable, and modular. Boundary: excludes individual module geometry unless needed to explain the technique. |- | ICHL-043 || [[File:043_Materials_Handling.webp|80px|link=Materials Handling]] || [[Materials Handling|Materials Handling]] || Materials Handling || '''Logistics / construction process.''' Scope: Defines movement, staging, batching, and point-of-use delivery of materials during the build. Boundary: excludes material design/specification and off-site supply-chain management. |- | ICHL-044 || [[File:044_Panel_Lift.webp|80px|link=Panel Lift]] || [[Panel Lift|Panel Lift]] || Panel Lift || '''Construction tool / equipment.''' Scope: Defines use and relevant configuration of the panel lift for ICHL construction. Boundary: excludes the building component being acted on and unrelated equipment capabilities. |- | ICHL-045 || [[File:045_Electrical_Wiring_Ergonomics.webp|80px|link=Electrical Wiring Ergonomics]] || [[Electrical Wiring Ergonomics|Electrical Wiring Ergonomics]] || Electrical Wiring Ergonomics || '''Work-method / human-factors process.''' Scope: Defines body positioning, routing strategy, tool placement, and sequence choices that make electrical wiring faster and safer. Boundary: excludes electrical-code requirements and circuit design except where they constrain the work method. |- | ICHL-046 || [[File:046_wall_building_jig.webp|80px|link=wall building jig]] || [[wall building jig|Wall Building Jig]] || wall building jig || '''Tooling / fabrication aid.''' Scope: Defines the reusable wall building jig used to locate, guide, hold, or repeat construction operations. Boundary: excludes the finished building part and general-purpose tools not specific to the jig. |- | ICHL-047 || [[File:047_saw_guide_jig.webp|80px|link=saw guide jig]] || [[saw guide jig|Saw Guide Jig]] || saw guide jig || '''Tooling / fabrication aid.''' Scope: Defines the reusable saw guide jig used to locate, guide, hold, or repeat construction operations. Boundary: excludes the finished building part and general-purpose tools not specific to the jig. |- | ICHL-048 || [[File:048_cabinet_hinges.webp|80px|link=cabinet hinges]] || [[cabinet hinges|Cabinet Hinges]] || cabinet hinges || '''Hardware / part family.''' Scope: Defines cabinet hinge hardware and the mounting/adjustment interface between cabinet box and door. Boundary: excludes cabinet-box geometry beyond hinge mounting and non-cabinet door hardware. |- | ICHL-049 || [[File:049_overhead_crane.webp|80px|link=overhead crane]] || [[overhead crane|Overhead Crane]] || overhead crane || '''Construction tool / equipment.''' Scope: Defines use and relevant configuration of the overhead crane for ICHL construction. Boundary: excludes the building component being acted on and unrelated equipment capabilities. |- | ICHL-050 || [[File:050_marking.webp|80px|link=marking]] || [[marking|Marking]] || marking || '''Construction process.''' Scope: Defines reference-mark creation for cuts, holes, locations, and assembly alignment. Boundary: excludes the downstream cutting/fastening operation and design dimensions that originate elsewhere. |- | ICHL-051 || [[File:051_cutting.webp|80px|link=cutting]] || [[cutting|Cutting]] || cutting || '''Fabrication process.''' Scope: Defines methods and execution boundaries for cutting building materials to documented dimensions. Boundary: excludes measurement/design definition and downstream assembly/fastening. |- | ICHL-052 || [[File:052_efficient_trenching_between_confined_end_points.webp|80px|link=efficient trenching between confined end points]] || [[efficient trenching between confined end points|Efficient Trenching Between Confined End Points]] || efficient trenching between confined end points || '''Construction technique.''' Scope: Defines an efficient method for excavating a trench when both endpoints or working clearances are constrained. Boundary: excludes the utility design itself and general open-site trenching without the constraint. |- | ICHL-053 || [[File:053_concrete_mixing.webp|80px|link=concrete mixing]] || [[concrete mixing|Concrete Mixing]] || concrete mixing || '''Material preparation process.''' Scope: Defines batching and mixing concrete to the required consistency and quantity for a construction task. Boundary: excludes formwork, reinforcement, placement geometry, and cured-concrete finishing. |- | ICHL-054 || [[File:054_material_calculations.webp|80px|link=material calculations]] || [[material calculations|Material Calculations]] || material calculations || '''Calculation / engineering process.''' Scope: Defines methods for deriving material quantities from geometry, BOM assumptions, waste factors, and build scope. Boundary: excludes procurement policy and the physical material itself. |- | ICHL-055 || [[File:055_building_as_a_mental_game.webp|80px|link=building as a mental game]] || [[building as a mental game|Building As A Mental Game]] || building as a mental game || '''Human-factors / training concept.''' Scope: Defines mental models, attention practices, and cognitive strategies for effective building. Boundary: excludes physical construction geometry and formal safety procedures except where directly referenced. |- | ICHL-056 || [[File:056_extreme_collaboration.webp|80px|link=extreme collaboration]] || [[extreme collaboration|Extreme Collaboration]] || extreme collaboration || '''Collaboration process.''' Scope: Defines high-parallelism team coordination, role handoffs, and swarm-build working methods. Boundary: excludes the physical modules being built and formal organizational governance beyond the build process. |- | ICHL-057 || [[File:057_airless_sprayer.webp|80px|link=airless sprayer]] || [[airless sprayer|Airless Sprayer]] || airless sprayer || '''Construction tool / equipment.''' Scope: Defines use and relevant configuration of the airless sprayer for ICHL construction. Boundary: excludes the building component being acted on and unrelated equipment capabilities. |- | ICHL-058 || [[File:058_build_rate_specifications.webp|80px|link=build rate specifications]] || [[build rate specifications|Build Rate Specifications]] || build rate specifications || '''Performance requirement / metric set.''' Scope: Defines target production rates or time-per-task expectations used to plan and validate build workflows. Boundary: excludes quality criteria, geometry, and crew policy except where they affect measured rate. |- | ICHL-059 || [[File:059_filling_holes.webp|80px|link=filling holes]] || [[filling holes|Filling Holes]] || filling holes || '''Repair / finish process.''' Scope: Defines filling unwanted holes or depressions in designated substrates before finish. Boundary: excludes intentional penetrations, structural repairs, and full-surface finishing. |- | ICHL-060 || [[File:060_tool_holders.webp|80px|link=tool holders]] || [[tool holders|Tool Holders]] || tool holders || '''Construction tool / equipment.''' Scope: Defines use and relevant configuration of the tool holders for ICHL construction. Boundary: excludes the building component being acted on and unrelated equipment capabilities. |- | ICHL-061 || [[File:061_sanding.webp|80px|link=sanding]] || [[sanding|Sanding]] || sanding || '''Surface-preparation process.''' Scope: Defines abrasion/smoothing of designated surfaces to the condition required for finish. Boundary: excludes material removal that changes design geometry and the coating/finish application itself. |- | ICHL-062 || [[File:062_caulking.webp|80px|link=caulking]] || [[caulking|Caulking]] || caulking || '''Sealant / finishing process.''' Scope: Defines application of flexible sealant at designated joints and gaps for air/water/finish closure. Boundary: excludes structural joints, primary flashing systems, and unrelated adhesives. |- | ICHL-063 || [[File:063_cleanup.webp|80px|link=cleanup]] || [[cleanup|Cleanup]] || cleanup || '''Construction housekeeping process.''' Scope: Defines removal/sorting of debris, tool/material reset, and work-area condition required between or after tasks. Boundary: excludes demolition, final commissioning, and off-site waste-system design. |- | ICHL-064 || [[File:064_vinyl_flooring_installation.webp|80px|link=vinyl flooring installation]] || [[vinyl flooring installation|Vinyl Flooring Installation]] || vinyl flooring installation || '''Flooring installation process.''' Scope: Defines preparation, layout, cutting, joining, and placement of vinyl finish flooring. Boundary: excludes subfloor structure, other flooring materials, and transition details except at interfaces. |- | ICHL-065 || [[File:065_design_rationale.webp|80px|link=design rationale]] || [[design rationale|Design Rationale]] || design rationale || '''Design rationale / decision knowledge.''' Scope: Captures why a design or construction choice exists, including tradeoffs and constraints. Boundary: excludes the authoritative geometry or requirement itself; those should live in their respective objects. |- | ICHL-066 || [[File:066_foundation_squaring.webp|80px|link=foundation squaring]] || [[foundation squaring|Foundation Squaring]] || foundation squaring || '''Layout / validation process.''' Scope: Defines measurement and adjustment used to establish square foundation geometry from datums/diagonals. Boundary: excludes foundation excavation/pour and above-grade framing. |- | ICHL-067 || [[File:067_roof_membrane_detail.webp|80px|link=Membrane Detail]] || [[Membrane Detail|Roof Membrane Detail]] || Membrane Detail || '''Roof-envelope detail.''' Scope: Defines the local roof-membrane geometry at a specific edge, penetration, transition, or termination condition. Boundary: excludes the entire roof membrane field and supporting roof structure. |- | ICHL-068 || [[File:068_truss.webp|80px|link=Truss]] || [[Truss|Truss]] || Truss || '''Structural assembly.''' Scope: Defines a generic truss as a load-bearing triangulated roof/long-span framing assembly and its member/connective geometry.
